prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Wide shot. A family of eight seen from behind, their faces never visible, in ankle-length rough undyed wool robes and head-cloths, barefoot, sit together at a dark square opening in rough pitch-black timber and watch an empty evening sky over still water. Evening, warm low light on the water. Waiting. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
